reviews.x: The polish is amazing!! Perfect for all of the true holosexuals out there!! Looks good over black polish, but looks of on its own too!!

reviews.t: This is the best Holographic nail polish there is!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:40ae40ac35981c7cb70a7ddcdfc30f12]] This is the best Holographic nail polish ever!! I got the pink instead of silver because with other Holographic nail polish brands it didn’t look Holographic in regular lighting so I didn’t want an awkward grey color. But I think I’m gonna get that one too because this is Holographic in all lighting!! And of course better with flash/sunlight. Goes on smooth not chunky at all. It’s beautiful and perfect!!just like so gorgeous to look at it’s a shiny fi
This nail polish is absolutely stunning and truly holographic! Perfect for all the true holosexuals out there!
Very very beautiful. I am very satisfied with my purchase. Only 2 coats needed. Worth the price. Packaged very carefully in bubble wrap! Fast shipping. Will definitely be buying more colors.

reviews.t: Hands Down the Best Nail Polish Brand.
reviews.x: Love this color. Color club is one of the few nail polishes that looks the same on your nails as it does in the bottle. So vibrant, iridescent and fast drying!

At first, I was disappointed because the color looked more neutral in the bright fluorescent light in my bathroom. However, it's a gorgeous lavender/pink in different lighting. Love the holographic effect. Was very pleased by how well the polish goes on - almost didn't need a second coat. Usually my nail polish chips within 2 days, but it was 5 days before I got a minor chip and I didn't even use a protective clear coat. Will probably be getting other colors of this brand and giving this as a gi
Love this color and holographic effect! It goes on smooth and dries quickly.

reviews.t: pretty but not holographic...just slightly sparkly
reviews.x: The nail polish is very light. One coat offers only a sheer color change. Two coats is a little better but still not enough to get that true halo color change and only noticeable is full sun.  The sparkle is merely pink and purple glitter. I would say not really worth the price. If you're looking for halo nail polish, there are much better ones out there.  I may keep it but only because I don't want to deal with the hassle of returning it.  All in all, not what I was hoping for.

Gorgeous! This polish goes on very smoothly and easily. It only took two coats and it dried very fast. The color is a beautiful sparkly lavender when it’s not in sunlight. When you’re outside in the sun it is a gorgeous holographic lavender/mauve pink. I highly reccomend.
Stunning!!! Absolute love!! This is with the flash. But My lighting sucks with out. So beautiful in person. Drys faster then some polish and shipping came right when said and packaged nicely.

reviews.t: It's beautiful the way it changes color in lighting
reviews.x: I constantly get asked what color I am wearing. It's beautiful the way it changes color in lighting.  The polish is average on how long it last, even with base and top coats.
This regular halo nail polish is absolutely stunning!  When under bright light, it sparkles and shines like a light show!  In little to no lighting, it looks like faded light pink polish.

reviews.t: I LOVE it! It usually stays on my toes without ...
reviews.x: I pick this color at the salon when I get pedicures. I LOVE it! It usually stays on my toes without any chipping for 1.5-2 months.

This is exactly what I was looking for. The color payout is amazing and it’s regular nail polish. It is what holo dreams are made of. Buy it, you won’t be disappointed. Bottle is full sized and brush is thin but fans out nicely.  Pic is in indoor lighting.
This color is pink & hologrophic. It is absolutely beautiful. It is flattering on anyone. I think the pictures others have posted here do a good job of representing the color.

reviews.t: It's so pretty in direct light
reviews.x: This covers so well, and no bubbles! It seems no matter how careful I am doing a manicure I always get a few bubbles, but not with this! It's so pretty in direct light, too.
Love this nail polish. Put on a black basecoat, then used this Polish, one coat. The holographic look is amazingly beautiful. Well worth the money. Will be buying more.
[[VIDEOID:b6bf05e4e06c13d37a0f6409b427d1b8]] It’s really easy to apply and it’s super pretty in bright light.
I love it just color looks a little different than in the picture but I love it would definitely buy more.
LOVE LOVE LOVE this polish!!!!  My new favorite, especially great for the beach!
Nice blue and pink, red and green holographic stripes.

Love love LOVE this nail polish. I used two coats and it dried relatively quickly and doesn’t chip easily!! It dries very hard almost like a gel, it’s beautiful in the sunlight and shimmers somewhere in between a purple silver indoors but is a spectrum of all the colors while outside!! I’ve gotten so many compliments on this polish- I’m in love with it.

Came well packaged. Nail polish itself is fairly quick drying and more opaque than I assumed it would be so that's nice. The color is pretty when the holo is vibrant but otherwise, it's a pretty bland pale purple imo. I would recommend it, the color is just not my cup of tea (which is my own fault)

It’s amazing. Other holographic nail polishes I’ve bought were really more of a shimmer but this is legit. I couldn’t stop staring at my hands for the first couple days lol. It also stays on really well too. I’ll definitely buy more in the future when I run out.

It would be much easier to tell you what I didn’t like. Because there wasn’t anything I didn’t like about this nail polish. Looks beautiful on went on perfectly and has lasted so for over two weeks without any signs of wear on it! Love love this nail polish ❣️

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the polish as stunning, gorgeous, and truly holographic, with a strong color shift in different lighting.
Many reviewers note it applies smoothly and dries quickly, often needing only about two coats.
Several reviewers praise the packaging and shipping, mentioning careful bubble wrap and fast delivery.
A few reviewers mention the color looks different or less holographic in certain lighting, such as fluorescent or indoor light.
One reviewer felt the polish was not truly holographic, only slightly sparkly, and not worth the price.
